title: SYNTHETIC Chronic Kidney Disease Protocol
synthetic_notice: SYNTHETIC protocol for CKEA demonstration only. Not real guidance.

sections.section_text: Start ramipril 2.5 mg once daily in adults with chronic kidney disease and an albumin-to-creatinine ratio of 30 mg/mmol or above.
Check serum potassium within 2 weeks of starting ramipril.
Offer sodium bicarbonate 500 mg three times daily when serum bicarbonate is below 20 mmol/L.
